scale.h2: text-2xl md:text-3xl font-semibold border-b border-zinc-800 pb-2

buttons.style: rounded-none border border-zinc-700 bg-transparent hover:bg-zinc-900 hover:border-zinc-500 transition-all text-sm font-mono uppercase

cards.style: rounded-none border border-zinc-800 bg-[#0A0A0A] p-6 shadow-none

inputs.style: rounded-none bg-black border border-zinc-800 focus:border-zinc-500 focus:ring-0 font-mono text-sm placeholder:text-zinc-700

sidebar.style: fixed inset-y-0 left-0 z-50 w-64 bg-[#0A0A0A] border-r border-zinc-800 flex flex-col

visual_enhancers.textures: Optional: Subtle scanline overlay or dot grid pattern in empty states
visual_enhancers.animations: Minimal. Instant state changes or very fast (100ms) opacity transitions. No bounces or springs.

icons.usage: Minimal. Use only for functional actions (download, copy, external link). Avoid decorative icons.

landing.layout: Centered vertically, but left-aligned text. Big ASCII-style or Mono title.

universal_rules: NO center alignment for body text (always left)
NO marketing fluff (keep it dry, technical, 'spec-like')
ALWAYS use Monospace for numbers, data, and UI labels
Dark Mode ONLY (Force 'dark' class on html/body)
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a tool for audio engineers and cryptographers. They value precision over beauty. The UI should feel like a well-crafted CLI tool that happens to be in a browser. Use 'JetBrains Mono' (from Google Fonts) for all headings. Ensure the 'Verify' flow feels robust—like a bank vault opening, not a confetti party.
